plan.planning_summary: Refining route_02 (Ge/ZnS dual-band IR filter) based on prior iteration evidence. Iteration_06 achieved best_target_score 0.8679 with [100-500] nm bounds; iteration_10 achieved 0.7743 with constricted [80-400] nm bounds, suggesting over-constraint limited exploration. Following feedback directives: expand thickness bounds to [20-450] nm, use random midpoint initialization near 220 nm with ±40% variance, disable adaptive step-scaling initially. Four complementary routes explore: (1) wide-bound unconstrained exploration, (2) asymmetric layer sequence, (3) reduced 18-layer count for manufacturability, (4) gradient-only optimization with decaying perturbation.

routes.scientific_hypothesis: Expanding thickness bounds to [20-450] nm with random midpoint initialization (220 nm ±40%) will enable the optimizer to discover phase-matched configurations that quarter-wave constrained initialization missed, improving best_target_score beyond 0.8679.
routes.design_principle: Transfer matrix method optimization with unconstrained thickness exploration allows discovery of non-quarter-wave solutions that may better satisfy dual-band transmission requirements while maintaining blocking.

routes.execution_request_english: Optimize a 22-layer alternating Ge/ZnS dielectric stack on CaF2 substrate for dual-band infrared transmission. Layer sequence: Ge|ZnS|Ge|ZnS|Ge|ZnS|Ge|ZnS|Ge|ZnS|Ge|ZnS|Ge|ZnS|Ge|ZnS|Ge|ZnS|Ge|ZnS|Ge|ZnS (22 finite layers). Initialize all layer thicknesses with random uniform distribution centered at 220 nm with ±40% variance (range approximately 132-308 nm initial). Set optimization bounds to [20, 450] nm for all 22 thickness variables. Disable adaptive step-scaling for first 50% of optimization budget. Use coherent transfer matrix solver at normal incidence. Wavelength range 2500-5000 nm. Four mean-transmittance objectives: maximize in 3250-3350 nm (methane band), maximize in 4200-4300 nm (CO2 band), minimize in 2500-3100 nm (blocking), minimize in 4450-5000 nm (blocking). Run both gradient_thickness and differential_evolution_thickness optimizers. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, and thicknesses_nm for all candidates. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 2500-3100 nm, 3250-3350 nm, 4200-4300 nm, 4450-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 3.25-3.35 um and 4.20-4.30 um bands; Low transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count <= 24; No metal layers; Conventional depositable infrared inorganic dielectric materials only.
routes.revision_reason: Expanded thickness bounds from [80-400] nm to [20-450] nm per feedback directive; replaced quarter-wave constrained initialization with random midpoint distribution (220 nm ±40%); disabled adaptive step-scaling initially to prevent premature convergence to phase-mismatched states observed in iteration_10.

routes.design_principle: Asymmetric layer sequences allow different effective cavity lengths for different wavelength bands, enabling independent optimization of methane and CO2 transmission peaks without compromising blocking regions.

routes.design_principle: Fewer layers reduce vacuum chamber residence time and cumulative thickness control errors, as evidenced by manufacturability constraints in infrared coating production (evidence shows 20-40 micrometer thickness limits for commercial viability).

routes.design_principle: Gradient-based optimization with controlled step decay allows efficient exploration early (large perturbations) followed by fine-tuning (small perturbations), avoiding the computational overhead of differential evolution while maintaining convergence quality.

research_influence: Evidence s2-chunk:CorpusId:139773493:s2chunk:139773493:25021:26346:5f1917d4b80dcb33 validated Ge/ZnS material pair for methane sensor bandpass filters at 3300 nm, supporting continued use in all routes.

Evidence s2-chunk:CorpusId:227248144:s2chunk:227248144:13756:16101:11bc1b8f56987299 confirmed alternating high/low index dielectric stacks produce sharp spectral profiles, supporting alternating topology in routes 01, 03, 04.

Evidence s2-chunk:CorpusId:17683472:s2chunk:17683472:29776:32010:c36d261f52b76fe1 motivated route_02_refine_03's 18-layer reduction by highlighting manufacturability constraints on coating thickness and layer count.

Evidence s2-chunk:CorpusId:235711786:s2chunk:235711786:15932:18147:495c8f99ee6e0507 supported TMM-based dual-objective optimization approach and informed route_02_refine_04's gradient-only with decaying perturbation strategy.
Prior iteration_06 best_target_score 0.8679 established performance baseline; iteration_10 score 0.7743 with constricted bounds informed feedback directive to expand bounds to [20-450] nm.
